issue.message: S04 shows session type, client name and project name through refs but reads load no SessionType, Client or Project. Fix: Add reads that load SessionType, Client and Project (e.g. getSessionType/listSessionTypes, getClient/listClients, getProject/listProjects) alongside listSlots, listBookings, listNotes and listTasks.

entries.reason: Fixed: S04 reads now include listSessionTypes, listClients and listProjects to load session type, client and project names shown through refs.

issue.message: S06 shows bookings with session type and slot time and projects with open task count but reads have no Slot, SessionType or Task. Fix: Add reads that load Slot and SessionType for each booking row and Task for the open task count (e.g. listSlots/getSlot, getSessionType/listSessionTypes, listTasks).

entries.reason: Fixed: S06 reads now include listSlots, listSessionTypes and listTasks for booking slot/time and project open counts.

issue.message: S07 shows each project's client name through Project.client but reads load no Client. Fix: Add a Client read (listClients or getClient) to load each project's client name.

entries.reason: Fixed: S07 reads now include listClients to load each project's client name.

issue.message: S08 shows the project's client name through Project.client but reads load no Client. Fix: Add a Client read (listClients or getClient) to load the project's client name.

entries.reason: Fixed: S08 reads now include getClient to load the project's client name.

issue.message: S13 shows the booking's session type but reads load no SessionType. Fix: Add a SessionType read (getSessionType or listSessionTypes) to load the booking's session type name.

entries.reason: Fixed: S13 reads now include getSessionType to load the booking's session type.

issue.message: S15 shows session type and slot date/time through refs but reads load only getBooking. Fix: Add Slot and SessionType reads (getSlot/listSlots and getSessionType/listSessionTypes) to load the slot time and session type shown.

entries.reason: Fixed: S15 reads now include getSlot and getSessionType alongside getBooking.

entries.reason: Added FD26 as name and FD27 as email to createClient so F35.S03 is served by the booking fields.

issue.message: getClient serves a Client read matched by email in the booking flow but takes no inputs. Fix: Add input FD27 as email so the Client read by matching email in F35.S03 is found by the typed email.
